purpose: Request packet for remaining official Alaska 2024 source gaps after ENRbyPrecinct.csv review rows were loaded.

officialSourceLeads.notes: Official All Details page for the 2024 General Election. Existing evidence records Summary PDF, ENRbyPrecinct.csv, HD SOVC PDFs, CVR export ZIP, and RCV report links.
Official ENR precinct/reporting-unit CSV loaded for President and U.S. Representative named-candidate first-choice review rows.
Official CVR export URL is identified by the All Details evidence, but this worker did not normalize CVR availability or CVR rows.
Official U.S. Representative ranked-choice report URL is identified for RCV context, but it does not replace same-grain write-in allocation by reporting unit.

The official Election Results page describes certified result search and historical election results dating back to 1958. Use it to collect 2020, 2016, and 2012 official presidential baseline artifacts.
Use the Division contact path for source-side confirmation or records routing if the All Details page does not publish the requested row-level artifact.

requests.neededArtifact: U.S. Representative write-in allocation by precinct/reporting unit, or written confirmation that ENRbyPrecinct.csv intentionally omits U.S. House write-in rows at that grain.
requests.sourceEvidence: ENRbyPrecinct.csv reconciles named U.S. House DEM and REP first-choice totals but is 750 votes below the Election Summary Report U.S. House total because write-ins are not itemized by reporting unit.
requestFields: write-in vote count by reporting unit
whether the rows are first-choice only
whether omitted write-ins are intentionally available only statewide
requests.caveat: Do not allocate the 750 write-ins proportionally or infer local write-in rows without an official source.

requests.neededArtifact: Official precinct/reporting-unit geometry or crosswalk that distinguishes election-day precincts from district absentee, early-voting, question, remote, and HD99 federal/overseas absentee rows.
requests.sourceEvidence: The loaded ENR review rows include mixed reporting units; House District geometry is retained only as a lead.
requests.caveat: Keep AK map-disabled until a reviewed crosswalk supports geometry joins.

requests.neededArtifact: Division of Elections interpretation of ENRbyPrecinct.csv Reg_voters and total_ballots fields, including denominator timing and whether mixed reporting units can be used for turnout rows.
requests.sourceEvidence: data/ak-2024-enr-turnout-semantics.json shows de-duplicated ENR Reg_voters sum 611,078 and total_ballots sum 340,981, matching EAC fallback and summary Times Cast totals. Wave 2 verification also found 120 zero-registration district absentee/early/question reporting units carrying 165,047 ballots, so ENR remains a documented lead rather than an active turnout replacement.
requestFields: handling for zero-registration district absentee/early/question units
whether federal/overseas HD99 belongs in statewide turnout
requests.caveat: Keep EAC fallback active. Do not replace active turnout with ENR rows until source semantics, denominator timing, and zero-registration district reporting-unit handling are confirmed.

requests.neededArtifact: Official 2020, 2016, and 2012 presidential result artifacts at statewide and preferably compatible local grain.
requests.sourceEvidence: The official Election Results page is the historical result search path; historical baseline rows are not active in AK ETL.
requests.caveat: Do not substitute secondary historical tables as official baseline rows without retaining the official artifact or caveat.

requests.neededArtifact: Official audit, CVR availability, recount, incident, correction, litigation, and records-request response artifacts.
requests.sourceEvidence: Equipment context is loaded from Verified Voting; official AK administration-context rows are not normalized. The official 2024 CVR ZIP URL is identified but not normalized.
requests.caveat: Administration-context rows are source/provenance context only and are not proof of fraud or misconduct.
